choices.content: Measuring only the school basketball team members
Randomly selecting 100 people from the list of all students at the school

question.prompt: To find out the average height of all students at a school, which of the following sampling methods is most reasonable?

solutions.explanation: Of the options, randomly selecting 100 students from the full school list gives every student an equal chance of selection and avoids restricting the sample to a role, a team, or one grade. This makes D the most reasonable choice, although a particular random sample can still be unrepresentative by chance.
